# Desk

> Open-source Java 25 development workbench with a Rust Ratatui TUI editor.

Site: https://desk.ajaytainwala.dev/
Repository: https://github.com/ajaytainwala-dev/desk
Releases: https://github.com/ajaytainwala-dev/desk/releases/latest

## What it is

Desk combines a terminal UI editor with a Java CLI for:

- Workspace management and multi-tab editing
- Java 25 baseline with per-workspace JDK pins (Temurin managed installs supported)
- Maven / Gradle / javac build and test orchestration with job cancel
- Live Eclipse JDT Language Server (completion, hover, diagnostics, workspace edits)
- Real JDI/JDWP debugging via `desk debug run` (CLI; no TUI debug panel in v0.1)
- Format, check, compile, run, Git helpers, and `desk doctor`

## Honest limits (v0.1)

- Interactive TUI debug panel is not shipped; F5 remains Run
- External DAP adapters are initialize-only
- `desk test --watch` is rejected until implemented

## Platforms

Windows (GUI installer + CLI setup + portable zip + TUI binary),
macOS (CLI setup + TUI binary),
Linux (CLI setup + portable zip + TUI binary).

## Install

- Website downloads: https://desk.ajaytainwala.dev/#downloads
- Windows PowerShell: `irm https://github.com/ajaytainwala-dev/desk/releases/latest/download/desk-cli-setup-windows.ps1 | iex`
- macOS / Linux: `curl -fsSL https://github.com/ajaytainwala-dev/desk/releases/latest/download/desk-cli-setup.sh | bash`
